metadata.industry: Test - Durable Object state sandwich migration
metadata.notes: Provisions a DO-bearing worker. Asserts the DO namespace is created on the destination account via the worker upload path (the engine's default behaviour). Does NOT exercise Step 3 state-copy — that requires a pre-run hook + Step 3 form-fill (sourceWorkerUrl/destWorkerUrl) which this config does not configure. To validate state copy, write a separate config that wires the Step 3 DO migration UI and use assertDoStateMigrated.

workers.name: do-state-worker
